notes: Clean SMA strategy one-pager with no planted issues; it shows net and gross 1-, 5- and 10-year and since-inception returns, balanced risks and full composite disclosures, plus two decoys (gross returns shown beside net, and a contributor list shown with total composite return).

decoys.span: For the periods ended June 30, 2026, the composite returned 12.64% net of fees and 13.60% gross of fees over one year, 7.35% net and 8.27% gross a year over five years, and 9.12% net and 10.05% gross a year over ten years.
decoys.why_ok: Every gross figure is paired with the corresponding net figure in the same sentence and table, with net stated first, and the net calculation method is disclosed.

decoys.span: Largest contributors: Orrinby Rail Components (+118 bps), Solvik Diagnostics (+94 bps) and Merriwell Packaging (+71 bps). Largest detractors: Cobden Specialty Chemicals (-83 bps), Haverdal Home Furnishings (-61 bps) and Brassfield Regional Bancorp (-44 bps). Over the same twelve months the composite returned 12.64% net of fees and 13.60% gross of fees. Contribution figures are calculated before fees from a representative account and are not the return of any holding or client account. A list showing the contribution of every holding during the period, and the calculation methodology, is available on request.
decoys.why_ok: The contributors are shown with an equal number of detractors, beside the total composite return net and gross for the same period, and a full contribution list for every holding is offered on request.
